scientific_integrity: Proof gives an explicit all-parameter construction and an independent general lower bound. Ten finite symbolic local factors cover every t≥0 by a formal block-interface argument; exhaustive finite graph checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Determines the entire n≡3 mod 5 class from n=8 upward, not n≡1 mod 5, small n=3 or n=6, or the number of distinct minimum solutions. Unindexed equivalent earlier work cannot be excluded; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A sharp infinite counterfamily to the prism locating-total domination conjecture
